certificate.title: Automate Monthly Allocations with Claude Cowork Completion

course.description: Turn a multi-hour monthly allocation process into a few minutes using Claude Cowork — with built-in checks to ensure debits equal credits. Based on Brock Beyer's allocation workflow.
learningOutcomes: Apply the methods taught in Automate Monthly Allocations with Claude Cowork.

lessons.content: In the Cowork desktop app, create a dedicated task for your monthly allocation work. Name it clearly — you'll reuse this every month.
lessons.title: Create a New Task Called 'Allocations'

activities.title: Write Clear Instructions for How Your Allocations Work

lessons.content: In the task description, explain: what costs need to be allocated, which departments are impacted, the allocation basis (e.g., headcount percentage), and any special rules. Be specific — treat this like onboarding a new staff accountant.
lessons.title: Write Clear Instructions for How Your Allocations Work

activities.title: Upload or Connect Your Source Data

lessons.content: Provide the file containing the costs to be allocated (export from your GL or ERP). If your ERP supports MCP, connect it directly so Cowork can pull the data automatically.
lessons.title: Upload or Connect Your Source Data

modules.title: Set Up Your Allocation Task in Cowork

lessons.content: Tell Cowork to: round to the nearest cent, ensure total debits equal total credits, validate that the corporate balance equals $0 after the allocating entry, and flag any allocation that seems unusual. These checks catch errors before they hit your books.
lessons.title: Build in Validation Checks

lessons.content: Ask Cowork to produce: (1) a clean, formatted reconciliation showing what was allocated and how, and (2) a journal entry document in the exact format your ERP needs for upload. If you use MCP, Cowork can propose the journal entry directly in your ERP.
lessons.title: Request Specific Output Formats

activities.title: Review the Output and Save as a Cowork Skill

lessons.content: Check the first run carefully. Once you're satisfied, save the entire workflow as a Cowork Skill so next month you just upload the new data and run the skill. What used to take 30 minutes to several hours now takes minutes.
lessons.title: Review the Output and Save as a Cowork Skill

modules.title: Validate, Format, and Save as a Skill
